topic: Campaign reporting time zone and date discrepancies
summary_markdown: Discussion focused on inconsistencies in campaign reporting data, specifically regarding time zones and date ranges. It was noted that the raw data received from the server contains dates and time zones as entered by the client, even though this input method is not used internally. The charts are generated with a 'D' (day) granularity. There is suspicion of further date shifting issues that require deeper investigation into the reporting mechanism.
decisions: A task/ticket will be created to investigate the reported time zone and date discrepancies.
action_items: Create a ticket for investigating campaign data inconsistencies.
